units.source_text: [\[7\]](#part1331.html#w7) 帷屏是置于贵妇人座侧以障隔内外之用具：

en.t: Curtain screens were furnishings placed beside noblewomen's seats to separate the inner space from the outside:

units.source_text: 在台座上竖立两根高约三四尺的细柱，

en.t: on a base stood two slender posts about three or four feet high,
and across the tops of the posts was set a long horizontal rail,

units.source_text: 在这横木上挂五幅垂布（冬天用熟绢，夏天用生绢或斜纹织物等）。

en.t: from which five panels of hanging cloth were suspended (smooth silk in winter, and raw silk or twill and similar fabrics in summer).
